title: LogicBeach: Powerful Moss

prize.note: the pot grows over time toward the contract's full balance; it was 0.54 ETH at the private research folder's prior check and 0.55 ETH on 2026-08-16, consistent with the contract's own time-based ramp, not a partial claim

addresses.label: prize contract
addresses.expected: 0.25 ETH minimum, growing toward the full contract balance

target_format: BIP39 12 words (English), BIP44 m/44'/60'/0'/0/0, no passphrase, address must equal the winner wallet authorized to call withdraw()

derivation.summary: read 12 words in clock order off the POAP clock-and-wordlist image, derive the BIP44 m/44'/60'/0'/0/0 address (plus a small account/index neighbor sweep), and compare it to the winner wallet the prize contract's withdraw() function accepts
derivation.certified_against: the public BIP39 all-zero-entropy test vector and the artist's own prior solved 'Bifurcations' BIP84 vector

difficulty_note: the carrier (the POAP clock image, not the audio), the order (clock position), and the derivation path are all confirmed; 3 of 12 hours read with no ambiguity and over 3.3 million combinations of the rest have been tested negative; the blocker is a resolution limit on the only known copy of the image (a numeral spans about 2 text rows, so 9 of 12 hours carry about 3 candidate words each), not raw compute, so an unrecovered insight into the exact readout rule or a finer source is what remains

leads.title: re-run the grid enumeration at a wider row window, one doubtful hour at a time
resample at the numeral's bottom pixel instead of its centroid
test the sunburst ray length as an alternative per-hour selector
